name: Eligibility 507.2 — Coverage Termination (Split Claim) Navigator
description: Resolve Edit PX_507 when the member is not covered for all dates of service: verify identity, look up the contract, confirm which claim line falls after termination, identify the claim-type scenario, split the out-of-window line into a new DCN, then submit Pay.

steps.name: Identify the PX_507 hard edit
steps.description: Navigate to the Event Resolution tab. A hard-edit card for Event PX_507 is displayed — this is the event to resolve. The card carries the bypass code PX_CB.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes as soon as the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab. The active PX_507 edit is shown in red, with the bypass code PX_CB on the card.
steps.checklistItem: PX_507 hard edit identified on Event Resolution

steps.name: Review member identity fields
steps.description: Open the Member Information tab and review the seven identity fields: First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix. These are cross-checked against the Claim Image next.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens Member Info for the first time.
steps.hint: Open the 'Member Info' tab. Note the seven highlighted identity fields — you'll compare them to the Claim Image next.
steps.checklistItem: Seven member identity fields reviewed on Member Info

steps.name: Cross-check member fields against the Claim Image
steps.description: Open the Claim Image tab and verify that the seven identity fields — First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix — match the Member Information tab exactly.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Image tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Image' tab. Compare the seven highlighted fields against Member Info — they must match exactly.
steps.checklistItem: Identity fields verified against the Claim Image

steps.name: Look up the contract on Search
steps.description: Navigate to the Search tab, select the Member sub-tab, and open the Member General Information section. Review the Business Unit field to determine the contract type. The available Business Unit values are Large Group, Small Group, and Individual. Large Group cases should be handled according to the dedicated SOP-defined process, while Small Group and Individual follow the standard shared process.  Here it reads 'Small Group', so record the Group ID, Member Prefix, Effective Date, and Termination Date.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member sub-tab inside Search.
steps.hint: Click 'Search', then the 'Member' sub-tab. Business Unit should read 'Small Group' — note the Group ID, Prefix, Effective Date, and End Date.
steps.checklistItem: Business Unit = Small Group; Group ID / Prefix / coverage dates recorded

steps.name: Confirm Group ID and Prefix on Member Info
steps.description: Return to the Member Information tab and confirm the Group ID and Member Prefix align with the Search → Member panel. The Group ID matches in this case.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Info tab while this step is active.
steps.hint: Return to the Member Info tab and review the Group ID and Member Prefix (highlighted) — both should match the Search → Member panel.
steps.checklistItem: Group ID and Member Prefix confirmed against Search

steps.name: Check service dates against coverage range
steps.description: Open the Claim Lines tab and verify each line's From / To dates against the Effective–End date range on the Member sub-tab. There are three claim lines; two fall within the range and one (line 3) falls outside it — that out-of-window line drives the split.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on first visit to the Claim Lines tab.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines'. Compare each line's From / To dates to the member's coverage window — line 3 is dated after the termination date.
steps.checklistItem: Claim line dates checked — line 3 falls after termination

steps.name: Identify the Claim Type
steps.description: Navigate to Claim Data tab, then Details sub-tab and review the Claim Type field. Here it is 'Professional', so the product must be checked next to pin down the claim-type scenario.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Details sub-tab inside Claim Data.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data', then the 'Details' sub-tab. The Claim Type field reads 'Professional'.

steps.name: Identify the Product
steps.description: Return to the Member Information tab and locate the Product field. Local and National are the two product types; if it were National the alternate SOP steps apply. Here the product is 'Local'.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Info tab while this step is active.
steps.hint: Return to the Member Info tab and review the Product field (highlighted) in the Group Information section — it reads 'Local'.

steps.name: Identify the Place of Service
steps.description: Locate the Place of Service (POS) in the POS field under the Claim Lines tab. Here POS is 20 — so the claim-type scenario is 'Professional / Local' with POS 20.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Lines tab while this step is active.
steps.hint: Open the Claim Lines tab and review the POS field (highlighted) — it reads 20. The scenario is 'Professional / Local', POS 20.
steps.checklistItem: Place of Service identified as 20 (Professional / Local)

steps.name: Split the out-of-range claim line
steps.description: Open the Action menu and select Split. In the Split Claim section, tick the checkbox of the claim line whose service dates fall outside the Effective–Termination range (line 3), click Move Claim Lines, then click Submit. Confirm the 'new claim created' pop-up with OK.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the claim split from the Split Claims panel.
steps.hint: Action menu → Split. Tick line 3 (dates after termination), click 'Move Claim Lines', then 'Submit'. OK the pop-up.
steps.checklistItem: Out-of-range claim line split into a new DCN

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: After confirming the split pop-up, open the Action menu, select 'Pay', and click the Submit button. The attempt finalizes and your time is recorded.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the Pay decision with the Submit button.
steps.hint: Action menu → Pay, then click Submit.
